channel.title: Hashbeam
channel.description: Hashbeam reports crypto news: protocol upgrades, network security, exchanges, stablecoins, regulation and market structure across blockchains and tokens.

item.title: HSBC brings RedCoin stablecoin to PayMe users
item.description: HSBC has launched RedCoin through PayMe, with wallet access rolling out to more than 3.3 million users and transfers, merchant payments and redemption handled in its apps.

item.title: How Omnichain Apps Move Assets and Calls Across Chains
item.description: Omnichain apps send messages between chains, but each transfer still depends on source and destination contracts, fees, and the route's security settings.

item.title: OCC rule leaves stablecoin rewards to case-by-case review
item.description: The OCC’s GENIUS Act rule bars issuers from paying yield directly but leaves intermediary rewards subject to a fact-specific test and anti-evasion scrutiny.

item.title: Tether wins 15 commitments for Bitcoin mining toolkit
item.description: Tether says 15 mining operators, hardware makers and pools will build MDK Workers, adapters meant to let applications work across their systems without replacing them.

item.title: What a Token Pause Does to Mantle Bridge Messages
item.description: A token pause can stop a Mantle bridge transfer before a message exists or make destination execution fail; the chain, contract and message status decide the outcome.

item.title: Solana replaces TowerBFT with Alpenglow consensus
item.description: Solana activated Alpenglow on Oct. 21, moving validator votes off-chain to target 150ms finality while leaving wallets, transaction execution and fees unchanged.

item.title: How to Pay a Bill on Another Blockchain
item.description: Paying across chains means matching the invoice’s network and asset, then sending funds there directly or bridging them before making a separate payment.

item.title: Kraken wins AFSA in-principle approval for Kazakhstan
item.description: Payward says AFSA has approved its Kazakhstan licensing application in principle for trading, investment dealing and custody, with a full licence still to come.

item.title: Why a Bridged Token May Not Pay Manta Pacific Gas
item.description: A bridged token does not automatically pay Manta Pacific fees: destination transactions need ETH, and each transaction carries execution gas plus an L1 data fee.

item.title: Native or wrapped tokens: choose by destination and control
item.description: Use the issuer’s native token where its official deployment is supported; choose a wrapped token when compatibility matters and its redemption path is clear.

item.title: OCC leaves stablecoin rewards open to case-by-case review
item.description: The OCC’s GENIUS Act rule keeps the ban on issuer-paid yield but leaves third-party stablecoin rewards to case-by-case review, without a safe harbor.

item.title: ZeroFi in 2026: How to Judge Bridge Routes
item.description: ZeroFi’s public bridge points to an XMR-to-zXMR flow, so route choice means weighing liquidity, execution cost and settlement delay around that path.

item.title: Read a Cross-Chain Swap Quote Before You Confirm
item.description: A cross-chain quote is an expiring execution plan, not a guaranteed price: compare net output, minimums, fees, route and settlement conditions before signing.

item.title: Polygon Bridge: Four Checks Before Moving Tokens
item.description: Polygon Bridge transfers depend on the route, token mapping and destination chain. Check those details and the withdrawal proof flow before moving funds.

item.title: Solana Schedules Alpenglow Consensus Switch for Wednesday
item.description: Solana’s Alpenglow consensus switch is scheduled for epoch 1064, replacing TowerBFT votes in blocks with certificates targeting 150ms finality.

item.title: Injective and BDACS plan KRW1 settlement for tokenized assets
item.description: Injective and BDACS will explore KRW1 settlement for tokenized assets, while issuance and redemption remain limited to approved institutions and regulatory clearance.

item.title: BaseSwap: How to Judge a Route for an Unfamiliar Pair
item.description: For an unfamiliar pair, BaseSwap’s quote is useful only after you check token identity, route depth, fees and minimum received against your trade size.

item.title: Three Checks for a Bridge Deposit Confirmation
item.description: A bridge status label does not prove a deposit is safe to credit; check source-chain inclusion, the exact deposit, and the destination transaction separately.

item.title: JPMorgan deploys its dollar deposit token on Ethereum
item.description: JPMorgan has deployed its dollar deposit token on Ethereum mainnet for institutional clients, extending JPM Coin beyond Base and widening onchain settlement options.

item.title: World ID targets banks as Zoom human checks go live
item.description: World introduced a World ID package for financial firms and made its Zoom human check generally available, extending its proof system into institutional workflows.
